# Gold Silver Acupuncture

> Traditional Chinese Medicine and acupuncture clinic in Columbus, OH, led by Dr. Xiumei Geng. Treats pain, migraines, women's health, anxiety, digestive issues, insomnia, and sports recovery.

Gold Silver Acupuncture provides personalized acupuncture and cupping therapy in a tranquil setting. Located at 4700 Reed Rd Suite F2, Columbus, OH 43220. Phone: (614) 270-7827. Booking handled externally via Jane App.
